description:
Query HD wallet data for UTXO blockchains (bitcoin, litecoin, bitcoin-cash, dogecoin, dash, zcash) by extended public key (xPub/yPub/zPub). The wallet must first be synced via manage_hd_wallet. Offset pagination: use 'limit' and 'offset' for paged results.

Actions:
• derive-receiving-address: Derive the next unused receiving address
• derive-change-address: Derive the next unused change address
• list-addresses: List all derived addresses for the wallet
• list-transactions: List transactions across all wallet addresses
• list-utxos: List unspent transaction outputs (UTXOs) for the wallet
• prepare-transaction: Build an unsigned UTXO transaction with automatic input selection
• list-assets: List token/asset balances held by the wallet
• get-details: Get wallet summary (total balance, address count, sync status)

Credits by action (source: OpenAPI):
• derive-change-address: 24
• derive-receiving-address: 24
• get-details: 12
• list-addresses: 12
• list-assets: 12
• list-transactions: 120
• list-utxos: 120
• prepare-transaction: 24

Credits are indicative only and may change at any time. The actual credits spent for each API request are returned in the response headers.

blockchain.description: UTXO blockchain (e.g. bitcoin, litecoin, bitcoin-cash, dogecoin, dash, zcash); required for all actions

context.description: Optional context for the request - echoed back in response

feePriority.description: Fee priority level (prepare-transaction only; defaults to standard)

limit.description: Max results per page (for list-* actions)

network.description: Network (e.g. mainnet, testnet); required for all actions

recipients.description: Array of {address, amount} objects (required for prepare-transaction)

name: hd_wallet__hd_wallet_data_utxo
